quick.q: What can AI do with a photo of a receipt?
options: Put the items into a table
Send the receipt to the shop

quick.q: How do you get a better AI-made image?
options: Describe the content, style and colours precisely

quick.q: The AI says what plant is in your photo. It matters (e.g. is it poisonous). What do you do?
options: Check with an expert or a reliable source

quick.q: What don't you send without permission?
options: Photos of other people's faces and documents
A photo of your own drawing

image.q: Where do you add a photo?
The AI described your photo (highlighted). The description is wrong. What do you do?
options: Say what's wrong and ask for a new analysis

challenge.task: Write a prompt for an AI image: a logo for your small business (bakery, hairdresser…).
checklist: What it will be used for
challenge.example: Create a simple logo for a small bakery called "Grain": an ear of wheat in a circle, warm brown and gold colours, minimalist style, looking good on a bag and on Instagram.
